stem: *Ranunculus* is a group (genus) of dicotyledonous plants that includes more than 1600 species.

parts.text: Name the cells labelled **A** and **B** in Fig. 1.1.

parts.text:
The procambium tissue shown in Fig. 1.1 consists of stem cells.

Suggest a role of the procambium tissue in the roots of this plant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Some species in the *Ranunculus* genus are xerophytes.

State **and** explain **two** adaptations of the leaves of xerophytic plants that reduce water loss.
